items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Truman Capote: “Richard, I just can’t understand why you’ve got a negro doing the music to a film with no people of coloring in it.”

ctx.x: That’s right. Put you in a bag. It was amazing, because then there were no black movies. In Cold Blood, we went through it. Truman Capote: “Richard, I just can’t understand why you’ve got a negro doing the music to a film with no people of coloring in it.”
In the Heat of the Night you had the same thing.
